name: Vula amacala esixazululi
panel.honest: Lungisa ucwaningo lapha, khiphe ifolda yecala elilungele ukusebenza ye-solver yangaphandle, yisebenzise kukhompyutha yakho, bese ubuyisa imiphumela. Osixazululi ngamaphrogremu ahlukile owengeza wena. Akukakaze kusebenziswe icala kulolu okwengeziwe kuma-solver angempela: hlola icala ngaphambi kokuthembela kulo.
target.label: Uhlobo lwecala
flow.external_note: Imodeli iyinto esebhokisini loketshezi. Izinhlangothi zebhokisi yilapho kungena khona, lapho kuphuma khona kanye nezinhlangothi ezishelelayo; izinhlangothi zemodeli ziyizindonga. Ku-PartCraft u-Y uphezulu.
flow.internal_note: Yenza imodeli ngqo njengento eqinile isikhala soketshezi uqobo (ngaphakathi kwepayipi, hhayi izindonga zalo). Khetha izinhlangothi zalo zokungena nokuphuma; izinhlangothi ongazikhethile ziyizindonga.
structure.note: Ibhalelwe {v}: ifayela lomyalo, imesh njengombhalo kanye nefayela lokusebenza. Ukuqina okulinganiselwe, impahla eyodwa.
impact.note: Ibhalelwe {v}: idekhi yokuqala nedekhi yenjini. Izinombolo ze-Johnson-Cook ngowakho ukuzithayipha; azikho ezisethiwe kusengaphambili.
faces.external_note: Udonga olunegama aludingeki: lunika lezo zinhlangothi indawo yazo, ukuze amandla azo afundeke ngokwawo.
mat.label: Impahla
export.units_flow: Izinhlamvu ku-mafayela: mitha, amakhilogremu, amasekhondi; i-mm yemodeli ibhalwa × 0.001. Ukucindezela kuyi-kinematic (ukucindezela ÷ ukuminyana).
export.units_structure: Izinhlamvu ku-mafayela: mm, itoni, s (ngakho N no-MPa). Ukuminyana kubhalwa nge-t/mm³ (kg/m³ × 1e-12). Ukushisa: mm, W, °C.
export.units_impact: Izinhlamvu ku-mafayela: itoni (Mg), mm, s (ngakho N no-MPa). Izivinini zibhalwa ngo-mm/s, ukuminyana nge-t/mm³.
results.how_flow: Emva kokusebenza, guqula nge-foamToVTK ku-ASCII (i-README inikeza umyalo) bese ukhetha amafayela .vtk ezinhlangothi zodonga, kanye nefayela lombhalo lamandla.
results.how_structure: Emva kokusebenza, khetha ifayela .resu. Gcina usayizi wesakhi njengoba wawunjalo lapho icala libhalwa.
results.how_impact: Emva kokusebenza, guqula ifayela ngalinye le-animation nge-thuluzi lesixazululi elithi anim_to_vtk (i-README inikeza umyalo) bese ukhetha amafayela .vtk.
plot.none: Akukho okuzodwetshwa okwamanje: ngenisa imiphumela kuqala.
plot.shown: Idwetshwe libekwe emodelini ({n} amabhendi emibala, {tris} amanxantathu, ukuguqula ×{scale}). Okuluhlaza kuyisilinganiso esiphansi kakhulu, okubomvu kuyisiphezulu kakhulu.
plot.shown_thinned: Idwetshwe libekwe emodelini ({n} amabhendi emibala, ukuguqula ×{scale}). Ubuso bunciphisiwe baba {tris} amanxantathu ukuze bulingane nesibonisi. Okuluhlaza kuyisilinganiso esiphansi kakhulu, okubomvu kuyisiphezulu kakhulu.
forces.title: Amandla ngesikhathi {t}
forces.note: Umugqa wokugcina wemigqa {n} yefayela lamandla, ngamanewtoni, ngama-axis wecala.
need.separate: Lawa maphrogremu ahlukile ku-CadCraft. Awe yingxenye yawo, futhi wena uwengeza kukhompyutha yakho. I-CadCraft ibhala kuphela amafayela ombhalo awo kanye nokufunda amafayela ombhalo awabhalayo.
need.never: I-CadCraft ayikwazi ukuqalisa iphrogremu kukhompyutha yakho: wena uqalisa osixazululi ngemiyalo ku-README yalo lonke icala.
msg.pick: Chofoza izinhlangothi zesakhiwo kumbono we-3D ukuze uzengeze: {id}, chofoza futhi ukuze uzisuse. Cindezela Ukukhetha kuqediwe uma usuqedile.
msg.no_faces: Lesi sakhiwo asinazinhlangothi ezinegama ezingakhethwa (sebenzisa i-mesh kernel noma i-exact kernel).
msg.max_faces: Inani eliphezulu lezinhlangothi kwisinto esisodwa ngu-64.
msg.no_part: Asikho isakhiwo esiqinile okwamanje. Qala ngokwakha isakhiwo.
msg.too_fine: Usayizi wesakhi omncane kangaka uzokwenza cishe izakhi {n}; umkhawulo lapha ngu-{max}. Sebenzisa usayizi omkhulu.
msg.stale: Isakhiwo sishintshile. Yenza imesh futhi uhlinzeke futhi.
msg.copy_none: Lesi sakhiwo asinaso ucwaningo lwe-Simulation noma izilungiselelo ze-Solid FEM ezinezinsiza noma imithwalo okufanele ikopishwe.
msg.written: {name} ibhaliwe: amafayela {n}. Yikhiphe, bese ulandela i-README yayo.
note.unrun: Akukho cala kulolu okwengeziwe elisebenzile kuma-solver angempela.
note.liability: Usizo lokuhlaziya, hhayi ukuvunywa kokwakha; unjiniyela wakho ubuyekeza imiphumela.
p.group_empty: {id} alinazinhlangothi emodelini. Khetha futhi izinhlangothi zalo.
p.faces_gone: {id}: ezinye zezinhlangothi zalo azisaseso esakhiweni futhi zishiywe ngaphandle.
p.many_cells: Imesh yangemuva yodwa inamaseli {n}. Sebenzisa iseli elikhulu noma imiphetho emincane.
p.no_inlet: Ukugeleza kwangaphakathi kudinga ukungena. Engeza esinye bese ukhetha izinhlangothi zaso.
p.no_outlet: Ukugeleza kwangaphakathi kudinga ukuphuma. Engeza esinye bese ukhetha izinhlangothi zaso.
p.no_location: Asikho iphoyinti koketshezi elingatholakala yi-mesher. Hlola ukuthi imodeli iyisikhala esivaliwe esiqinile.
p.inlet_not_flat: {id} ayilingene: isivinini sokungena sibhalwa ngokuqondene nevelu yayo ephakathi. Hlola kona.
p.bad_elements: Izakhi {n} azinavolumu. Yenza imesh futhi ngosayizi wesakhi ohlukile.
p.no_fixed: Akukho okubambe isakhiwo. Engeza izinhlangothi ezinqunyiwe.
p.modal_free: Akukho okubambe isakhiwo: imvamisa yokuqala yezi-6 izoba ngu-zero (isidumbu esikhululekile).
p.no_load: Alikho ithwala. Engeza amandla, ukucindezela noma isisindo sayo.
p.no_conductivity: Ucwaningo lokushisa ludinga ukuqhuba kokushisa. Thayipha kungaphansi kwempahla.
p.no_thermal: Ucwaningo lokushisa ludinga okungenani izinga lokushisa elilodwa noma ubuso bokuhamba kokushisa.
p.no_motion: Akukho okunyakazayo: nikeza isivinini sokuqala, izinhlangothi ezikhutshiwayo noma ugravithi.
p.many_cycles: Cishe izinyathelo zesikhathi {n}: ukusebenza isikhathi eside. Fushanisa isikhathi sokusebenza noma usebenzise usayizi wesakhi omkhulu.
